## f527b82316c1

Concrete dead-axis and validation defects are reproducible. With the same seed,
sample index, 6×6 grid, `density_kind="medium"`, and `n_colors=3`, requesting
`n_cells=1` and `n_cells=18` returns the **identical grid with nine nonzero
cells**. Likewise `palette_size=1` and `palette_size=8` return the same
three-color grid. A bogus override key is silently accepted and has no effect.
Finally, `self_check([[0,0],[0,0]])` returns no errors even though the declared
invariant requires at least one non-background cell. The focused lint also
fails because `RULE_HASH` is missing and `n_cells` has no probeable boundary.
Evidence: `checks/audit-target-probe.json` and
`checks/audit-probe-lint-f527b82316c1/`.
